headline: FCMB Group Nine-Month Pretax Profit Doubles to N272.8 Billion
summary: Nigerian financial services firm FCMB Group Plc posted a 103% year-on-year increase in pretax profit to N272.8 billion for the nine months ended September 2026.
why: FCMB is one of Nigeria's major commercial banking groups, reflecting domestic credit growth and FX revaluation dynamics.

impacts.name: FCMB Group
impacts.why: Pretax profit surged 103% to N272.8 billion in the first nine months of the year.
